integrity_note: The general theorem is proved directly from the defining equations. Exhaustive small-field checks are corroborative, not a proof in arbitrary dimension.
scientific_limitations: Only rank-at-most-one linear operators on split commutative unital radical-square-zero algebras are classified.
No scheme-theoretic multiplicities, full component decomposition, higher-rank systems or conjugacy orbits are determined.
Historical originality remains subject to independent literature assessment.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter systems on square-zero local algebras: incidence strata and a complete finite-field census
